title: Wildfly: specially crafted WS-Policy document can pack unlimited content inside a policy assertion,… (CVE-2026-91864)
description: A vulnerability in Wildfly allows a specially crafted WS-Policy document to embed unlimited content inside a policy assertion. This content is copied into memory by Neethi without enforcing size limits, leading to heap exhaustion and a denial of service condition. The flaw affects Wildfly versions prior to 42.0.0-r1 and has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 7.5. A patch is available in version 42.0.0-r1 to address this issue.
